description: Establish professional development environment with automated code quality tools, virtual environments, secrets management, and AI-assisted development workflows. Master the tooling foundation that will support efficient, high-quality Catchbook development.
catchbook_focus: Configure a production-ready development environment for Catchbook with ESLint, Prettier, pre-commit hooks, Claude Code CLI, Python virtual environments, environment variable management, and proper .gitignore patterns. Set the standard for professional repository hygiene.
entry_criteria: Completed Phase 1 (Git fundamentals, branching, PR workflow, Issues/Projects)
Catchbook repository initialized with professional README
VS Code or preferred IDE configured
exit_criteria: Catchbook repository with linting and formatting enforced on every commit
Claude Code CLI configured with comprehensive CLAUDE.md context file
Python virtual environment (venv or Poetry) active for Catchbook backend
.env file structure implemented with secrets properly managed
Production-ready .gitignore covering Node, Python, and IDE artifacts
Pre-commit hooks blocking commits with quality violations
Demonstrated ability to use Claude Code for common development tasks

modules.module_name: Development tools: ESLint, Prettier, hooks, Claude Code
modules.catchbook_deliverable: Claude Code configured for Catchbook project with CLAUDE.md context
